title: Reference AlwaysAllow Configuration
description: Configuration de reference pour l'auto-approbation des outils MCP sur toutes les machines Roo
issue: #3639 - roo-state-manager alwaysAllow recomputed against the served catalogue (33 -> 17); #1681 - SSH tools removed from default alwaysAllow

win-cli._comment: v1.3.0: SSH tools removed from alwaysAllow (#1681). SSH requires explicit per-task authorization.

roo-state-manager._comment: v1.4.0 (2026-09-14, #3639): recomputed against the catalogue actually served by ListTools (allToolDefinitions in src/tools/tool-definitions.ts), not inherited from history. Count 33 -> 17: added claudish_traffic, roosync_harmonization, roosync_messages; removed 19 names the server no longer advertises. Legacy names are worse than noise here -- they are redirect-only in registry.ts, so whitelisting them hid the gap between the reference and the live catalogue. Historical: v1.2.0 listed 34 (post CONS-1 -> #675); v1.3.0 claimed 15 (2026-05-19, already stale at the time).
